journey.name: USDT screens in German
journey.description:
The USDT screens show German text, not English fallbacks, when the app language is German, and no German label is cut off. Use a fresh onboarded wallet with USDT services and cross-network deposits configured, no USDT balance and no deposits. No payment is submitted. Brand and network names (USDT, Tether, Arbitrum, Tron) stay in English.
The journey changes only the app language and restores it at the end. Restart after each language change if the app asks for it.

actions.action: From Home, open the menu (id "HeaderMenu") and Settings (id "DrawerSettings"), open Language (id "LanguageSettings"), and record the currently selected language
Select Deutsch, confirm the change, then terminate and relaunch Bitkit and unlock if needed
On Home, verify the USDT intro sheet (id "UsdtIntro") shows "Neu: USDT", the heading "DOLLAR? DU ENTSCHEIDEST" and the button "USDT aktivieren", with no English text on the sheet
Tap "USDT aktivieren" and verify the USDT tile appears on Home
Open Receive, select the USDT tab and verify the title reads "Dollar empfangen" and the network control reads "Netzwerk: Arbitrum One"
Tap the network control and verify the network list is titled "USDT-Netzwerk" and its note starts "Hinweis: Unabhängig vom Empfangsnetzwerk"
On that list, tap "Einzahlungen anderer Netze" and verify the screen is titled "Einzahlungen anderer Netze" and the empty state reads "Noch keine Einzahlungen."; go back and close Receive
Open the USDT wallet, then Send, and verify the screen is titled "USDT senden" and the network row is captioned "Netzwerk"; go back without paying
Verify from screenshots of each screen above that no German label is truncated or overlaps its neighbour
Open Settings, Language (id "LanguageSettings"), select the language recorded at the start, then terminate and relaunch Bitkit
